Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

target noun

a goal to be reached

also aim (a goal), objective, set a target, meet a target, reach a target

classical

Hor. C. 3.3.1: tenācem prōpositī
Cic. Fin. 3.22: prōpositum assequī, to reach one’s aim (Lewis & Short)

prōpositum, prōpositī n.

noun, second declension

an aim, a purpose one has set oneself

Examples

  • jūstum et tenācem prōpositī virum

    the man who is just and holds fast to his purposeHor. C. 3.3.1

Other words

  • fīnis, fīnis m. — the end aimed at, a goal

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Quint. 2.17.22: fīnem aliquem prōpositum, ad quem tendunt (Lewis & Short)

  • mēta, mētae f. — the turning-post; the end one is making for

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Verg. A. 3.714: longārum haec mēta viārum (Lewis & Short)

    (in hōc sēnsū vōx plērumque poētica: Verg., Ov.)

See also target, plan, approach.

SourcesLewis & Short: propono · Lewis & Short: finis · Lewis & Short: meta
